notes.title: 5 Minutes Rage - Hatred Edition
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/fc6cde413dd324478e22ed25227c9d75fdc4a54e.png

Are you ready for a lot of additional hate, fury and envy? 
Here we are to delight you with the brand new 5 Minutes Rage - Hatred Edition! The 2.5D multiplayer game, half party game, half shooter, where 2 teams of junkbots fight until death to score a goal in a blaze of laser gun, explosive bullets and projectiles, is back with a completely new look. The Hatred Edition will be available for free for all the current owners of 5 Minutes Rages, of course! Check out the hateful contents you are going to enjoy in this frantic Hatred Edition:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png 2 incredible new maps to humiliate your enemies in
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png 10 new wonderful pieces to bring your junkbot customization to another level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png 2 additional backgrounds full of hate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26670790/588b1616684bfe847e2a660e43b3501d7260f661.png Achivements bug now fixed and general additional improvements

notes.title: Tutorial and double jump!
notes.content:
Patch 1020 release notes:
- Tutorial to learn moves and rules
- Double jump (cannot be done with ball)
- Auto switch between keyboard and gamepad (only with one local player)
- Normal projectiles are a little faster

notes.title: Patch 990M
notes.content:
- New sound effects
- Better ball rolling physics
- Accumulators slowly discharge when not active
- Moving parts of maps don't stutter anymore on clients
- Fixed wrong in-game menu display when opened by local player 2, 3 or 4
- Tweaked postprocess in some map

notes.title: Disco-ball and other updates!
notes.content:
Patch 975M release notes:
- Ball pulsates in time with the music, so that it is more visible
- Music in main menu
- New crosshair, more visible
- New ball physics (should be more reliable and never pass through walls)
- Character collision a bit higher to better fit head
- More responsive aim
- Number of votes shown in vote map menu
- Fixed barrier respawn effect
- New game icon, splash and loading screen
- Less obtrusive goal effects
- Sparkle particles now bounce on surfaces (how could we live without this?)
- Better camera positioning when entering a new map

notes.title: Patch with in-game emotes and chat!
notes.content:
Patch 931 release notes:
- Quick chat in-game (including emotes!)
- Chat box in lobby
- Aesthetic improvements of maps
- Cooler explosion dynamics
- Fixed bug that could let players keep firing or hold shield after getting the ball
- More precise time display on clients
- Ball loses charge after two bounces

notes.title: Patch with Skill Skull voice and various fixes
notes.content:
0.2.880 patch notes:
- Added Skill Skull voice sound
- Fixed bug that could freeze 2nd and 3rd clients at character respawn
- Music tracks should not desynchronize anymore
- Fixed infinite air jump while firing at a certain angle
- “Choose next map” button showed at the end of local matches, and hidden for clients in private matches
